summary.triplet_hits_note: BH within a triplet controls the chance of any false hit in that triplet at 5% when there is no interaction, so up to 0.05 x 512 = 25.6 triplets with a hit are expected by chance.

float32_measurement_floor.note: per-cell code changes are stored as float32 position means; differences of ~1e-8 to 1e-7 are rounding
